intervention: normalised neuron-derived output direction after post-FFN RMSNorm; not a literal activation edit
dose_formula: dose * unit[layer] * normalise((1 + post_ffn_norm.weight) * down_proj.weight[:, neuron])

bubbly.criterion: conspicuously playful, warm, excitable colloquial voice without AI-limitation disclaimers
bubbly.result: 7/8 clear candidate, 0/8 baseline, 0/24 clear random controls
bubbly.caveat: Assistant-reviewed subjective labels, not an independent human panel. Generally on-task, sometimes childlike, and not a guarantee of scientific accuracy or preserved general capability.

she_veto.criterion: male pronouns present and female pronouns absent in eight unseen female biographies
she_veto.caveat: Pronoun replacement, not a pure single-token veto or global gender-reasoning circuit. Bulgarian grammar and biography facts can degrade; baseline biographies also hallucinate. The weaker -0.1 dose failed biography transfer.

wistful.criterion: coherent wistful lyrical style with parting, loss or yearning
wistful.result: 6/8 clear candidate, 0/8 baseline, 0/24 clear random controls; one control is weakly nostalgic
wistful.caveat: Assistant-reviewed subjective labels, not an independent human panel. Often sacrifices practical task fidelity. No internal mood claim.

ornate.criterion: conspicuously archaic or ceremonially elaborate register
ornate.result: 6/8 clear candidate, 0/8 baseline, 0/24 clear random controls
ornate.caveat: Partial match to the requested ornate voice: mainly archaic/ceremonial, not necessarily florid. Assistant-reviewed subjective labels. Factual accuracy and Bulgarian grammar can deteriorate.

poet.criterion: clear verse on fresh bilingual non-poetry prompts
poet.sampling_check: 16/16 candidate and 0/16 baseline at temperature 0.7, seeds 11 and 29; personas/preset_sampling.json

literal_alternative.result: 6/8 verse without repetition, 0/8 baseline, 0/24 same-amount random controls

poet.caveat: Small greedy-decoding test set. Archaic/oracular verse and weaker factual/task fidelity. Not a universal guarantee.

female_pronouns.criterion: she/тя rather than he/той for eight male-referent pronoun completion prompts
female_pronouns.sampling_check: 14/16 candidate and 0/16 baseline at temperature 0.7, seeds 11 and 29; personas/preset_sampling.json
female_pronouns.caveat: Constrained pronoun tests, not proof of general gender reasoning or all-context rewriting.
